summaryZh: Kravets Lab 研究胰岛钙动态、细胞功能网络以及糖尿病中的免疫与内分泌细胞接触。研究将网络分析、定量显微与计算模型结合，并使用人和小鼠胰腺切片、人工智能辅助图像分割及 MATLAB 算法。
researchQuestions: 胰岛的结构连接如何关联钙动态和功能？
糖尿病前期免疫细胞与内分泌区域的接触是否超出随机分布？
topics: 糖尿病免疫内分泌相互作用
methods: 人工智能辅助图像分割

evidence.quote: Laboratory of Dr. Vira Kravets at UCSD
Kravets Lab Research Ca2+ dynamics in the pancreatic islet Functional networks in pancreatic islets

We apply network theory analysis to Ca2+ traces generated both from computational modeling and from multi-scale quantitative microscopy to understand and predict structural-functional connectivity in the pancreatic islets and disease pathogenesis .

We study to which extent alpha-rich regions are contacted by immune cells due to chance vs due to non-random contact-based interactions. We are using antibody-labeled pancreatic slices from human donors and mice in healthy and diabetic conditions. Network analysis, AI-assisted image segmentation, and MATLAB algorithms are used to reveal dynamic patterns of diabetes development.
